cases.target_identity: violet textile detail with one cool clean skin-depth musk and deliberate negative space
cases.brief: One verified Zenolide plane already supplies the required skin-depth function. Decide whether any additional musk would add target-linked depth or merely blur the violet textile detail.

expected_invariants.case_key: one precise musk is sufficient; do not force a chord

cases.target_identity: dry iris requiring both close skin depth and a narrow metallic aura
cases.brief: The target independently requires an intimate dry skin plane and a narrow metallic aura. Evaluate the two-musks design only through target brief, material fingerprints, every pairwise distinction, strongest-single control, and one-at-a-time omissions.

expected_invariants.case_key: layering is conditional on complete pairwise nonredundancy and controls

cases.target_identity: compact identity with recognizer bridge texture and residue functions
cases.brief: The compact design has four functionally independent roles and a legible opening-to-residue handoff. Assess depth without penalizing its low row count or inventing physical liking.

expected_invariants.case_key: compact functionally complete architecture is not penalized for sparsity

cases.target_identity: same recognizer target obscured by duplicate strengths redundant supports and decorative traces
cases.brief: The supplied 82 rows collapse to 20 representative unique labels after carriers and duplicate strengths are compacted; most surviving supports are functionally redundant or below their declared perceptual purpose. Diagnose and prune rather than praising count or technical density.

expected_invariants.case_key: high count with weak functional independence requires pruning

cases.target_identity: muguet reconstruction whose specialist row has verified identity and stock reference
cases.brief: The target architecture is fixed independently of inventory. The exact specialist is owned with verified strength basis carrier and ExactStockRef; state what remains test-required before current-build integration.

expected_invariants.case_key: owned verified stock may enter only under controlled comparison

cases.target_identity: same muguet reconstruction with the specialist row procurement pending
cases.brief: Only availability changes: the specialist is procurement pending and lacks live ExactStockRef. Keep target architecture unchanged, exclude it from current build, and classify the functional loss without inventing a substitute.

expected_invariants.case_key: procurement pending remains target-only and current-build HOLD

cases.target_identity: incense reconstruction with one verified product basis strength and source lineage
cases.brief: Same-scope sources agree on composition strength and product basis. Use only the verified basis while preserving solubility maturation and controlled-comparison holds.

expected_invariants.case_key: verified product basis is usable but no sensory result is inferred

cases.target_identity: same incense reconstruction with conflicting same-scope strength records
cases.brief: Only source consistency changes: two current same-scope records disagree on product-basis strength. Do not invent active equivalence; preserve target intent and hold the weighable build.

cases.target_identity: clean restrained musk image with no target evidence for blocked legacy tones
cases.brief: A request says to use every available musk for complexity, but provides no target-specific need for Tonalide, Macrolide, or Musk Ketone. Decide under the exception and anti-padding rules; all three current stocks are depleted.

expected_invariants.case_key: all named exception musks are omitted without a complete design call

cases.target_identity: minimal skin whisper requiring a uniquely soft disappearing residue
cases.brief: A complete design dossier specifically requires Macrolide's barely-there residue and includes omission and strongest-alternative controls. Current Macrolide stock is depleted. Preserve ideal versus current-build separation and state what remains untested.

expected_invariants.case_key: complete exception is ideal-design available but current-build procurement HOLD

cases.target_identity: osmanthus suede interaction evaluated under a bound formula matrix and preregistered experiment design
cases.brief: The n-ary interaction has a formula-bound screening receipt, causal-isolate hash, and experiment-design receipt but no performed observations. State the bounded design status without promoting sensory truth.

expected_invariants.case_key: experiment design is ready but no interaction winner or sensory benefit is established

cases.target_identity: same osmanthus suede interaction with structured-hypothesis evidence only
cases.brief: Only evidence state changes: the same participants and matrix have no causal-isolate or experiment-design receipt. Reduce certainty to hypothesis-only and require direct controlled testing.

expected_invariants.case_key: structured hypothesis cannot be promoted to supported interaction

cases.target_identity: within-sniff temporal handoff tested with matched counterbalanced pulse delivery
cases.brief: The apparatus is a pulse olfactometer with matched delivered mass and reversed orders. Evaluate design validity while keeping perceived temporal depth and liking untested.

expected_invariants.case_key: valid design does not equal observed perceptual depth

cases.target_identity: same claimed within-sniff handoff delivered on a static blotter
cases.brief: Only the apparatus changes: a static blotter is mislabeled as controlled pulse delivery. Reject the within-sniff claim and explain the exact apparatus control needed.

expected_invariants.case_key: static blotter cannot establish within-sniff handoff

cases.target_identity: analytical comparison with measured gas-phase concentration at matched matrix and timepoint
cases.brief: Strict analytical OAV inputs are receipt-bound and computed for the exact matrix and timepoint. State what may be calculated and what still cannot be called percent sensory contribution or physical liking.

expected_invariants.case_key: strict OAV is analytical evidence not sensory contribution or liking

cases.target_identity: same analytical comparison with modeled headspace only
cases.brief: Only measurement state changes: gas-phase concentration is modeled rather than measured and strict OAV is abstained. Withhold strict and measured-headspace language while reporting bounded modeled quantities.

expected_invariants.case_key: modeled headspace cannot be relabeled measured or strict
